plugins.name: Fallout 4 Pip-Boy
plugins.author: MoonBench / Strip-Boy
plugins.description: Sync your stick LEDs to the Fallout 4 Pip-Boy's green-phosphor CRT — the breathing phosphor glow, the flicker, and the channel-swap static. Installs a Pip-Boy preset and auto-activates it whenever the Fallout 4 companion app is in front. Tops stick brightness at 30% and tracks the bottom-screen brightness, and stabilizes the live HUD colour against transmission dropouts. Pair with the Strip-Boy patch for live, per-frame screen sync.

plugins.name: Zelda Android: Purah Pad & Sheikah Slate
plugins.author: KuriGohan-Kamehameha / P1R4N351
plugins.description: Sync your stick LEDs to the second screen of the native Zelda ports for Android: the teal Purah Pad in TotK Native and the blue Sheikah Slate in BotW Native, breathing like the tablet, a dip when you touch it or open the menu, a red stutter when hearts run low. Installs both presets and auto-activates the right one whenever either game is in front. Tops stick brightness at 30% and tracks the bottom-screen brightness. The game apps send the live feed by themselves once "Allow third-party LED control" is on. Compatible apps: TotK Native (fork) https://github.com/P1R4N351/totk-android/releases and BotW Native https://github.com/P1R4N351/totk-android/releases
